_about: The shared wool material (scripts/art/felt.gdshader) and how the builder makes meshes and stitches (scripts/art/felt_builder.gd). weaves: what a part (or a whole model, "weave") is made of, by the number the shader reads; knit_map and rib_map are for sculpted models (art/) whose second UV map is a stitch map (column, row), so V stitches follow their columns and ribs; yarn reads it as (round a strand in plies, along it in twists) for twisted curls; bead is smooth, for button eyes.

shells._about: Fuzz shells: count extra passes, each shell_height metres further out, keeping shell_keep of the fibre cells (strand_scale per metre) on the first and less beyond. Off for the presets listed.

miniature._about: The tilt-shift blur of the miniature look (scripts/art/miniature.gd): sharp from near_gap_m in front of the players to far_gap_m behind them, blurring over the transitions. Off for the presets listed.

turnaround._about: The --turn review capture (scripts/tools/capture.gd), a studio like the owner's turnaround sheet: backdrop and floor colour, a plain camera (no grading), a key light of key_color and key_energy from key_azimuth_deg round from the camera (positive to its left; the sheet is lit from its right) and key_elevation_deg up, turning with the camera, its shadows softened by key_softness_deg, ambient fill, the floor's shadow_strength, and a camera camera_distance_m away at camera_height_m aimed at aim_height_m through a fov_deg lens, drawn supersample times larger and scaled down (a photo's fine fuzz, not single-pixel speckle).
